title: BalaCraft
description: This mod adds Balatro cards to Minecraft. Each with their own specialties.
body:
### Balatro + Minecraft is weird, but here!

BalaCraft is a minecraft mod that adds Balatro's Jokers and a deck of cards into minecraft, each card does a special ability (or abilities)

Most or all of these versions will require specifically NeoForge 1.21.8.

### Adds cards from Balatro, specifically: 
Basic Joker - Adds +4 damage to punch damage. (equals 5 punch damage)
Heart Joker - Gives regeneration only if hand
Gros Michel - Adds +15 damage to punch damage. (equals 16 punch damage)
And more.

### Decorations are also existent too! Such as:
Deck of cards/Stack of cards
Ace (Could be used to make Jokers)
And more.

Each card have crafting recipes and rarity. Some Jokers can help, and others can literally be OP.

### And credits to the game Balatro and LocalThunk for the ideas of adding Jokers to minecraft!
